rationale: Seed 1101 controlled ablation improved scene AP, AUROC, recall at <=5% FPR, pixel Dice, and pixel IoU over mask-derived v5 while retaining a dense output. Confirm stability before opening the location test.

architecture.name: ersrr_methanes2cm_tri_temporal_context_v5_1
architecture.scene_head: 128-unit MLP over mean/max fused bottleneck and mean/max/min centered two-reference MBMP
architecture.segmentation: shared tri-temporal encoder, seven-term temporal fusion at five scales, U-Net decoder

training.augmentation: random right-angle rotations and horizontal/vertical flips

ensemble.scene_calibration: For each seed, transform any score to its empirical CDF percentile in that seed's frozen internal-development scores using right-continuous searchsorted; average the three percentiles equally.
ensemble.scene_thresholds: Select once on the internal-development ensemble for FPR targets 0.02, 0.05, 0.08, and 0.095.
ensemble.segmentation: Equal arithmetic mean of the three per-pixel sigmoid probabilities.
ensemble.pixel_threshold: Choose once on all observable internal-development pixels from the fixed 0.05 to 0.95 step-0.05 grid by maximum Dice; lower threshold breaks an exact tie.
ensemble.uncertainty: 2000 nonparametric bootstrap resamples of the 64 frozen 25 km internal-development groups.

promotion_rule: Complete all three seeds and freeze the aggregate calibrators, scene thresholds, pixel threshold, checkpoint hashes, and comparison code in a clean commit. Do not change architecture or operating rules in response to the location-test result.

test_models: frozen ERSRR v4.3 ensemble with its internal-validation rules
released MARS-S2L model with its released/frozen rules
sealed_test.rule: After campaign freeze, extract only the pinned location-test assets and run one comparison campaign. Never retune from its results.
